scope: Live reread of the prior selected 1,160 Current source paths, excluding Workbench/Workflow-named source files or active Subjects. No Current or code writes.

36 actual named Relation operators observed in bounded fenced CFEL have an exact descriptor Declaration. Generic ((RELATION)) and Relation//RELATION_NAME are syntax placeholders declared by R2609/R2613 and R2720, respectively; do not create Relations for them.

Descriptor inventory records each source pin, classification, reciprocal binding, declared aliases and full formal CFEL Claims. Relation//NAME denotes a descriptor; ((NAME)) in signatures denotes the named Relation. No declaration contains a cardinality placed on a named Relation descriptor as if it were an endpoint.
No unambiguous nonexcluded source repair was established in this bounded pass; therefore no source preview has been invented.
limitations: The prior selected frontier is a bounded source selection, not an all-live census. This pass scans fenced CFEL operators; prose-only, dynamic/wildcard names, plugin/code surfaces, and excluded Workbench/Workflow sources are not proven complete.

Some endpoint signatures use intentionally generic variables; their kinds/populations and effective inherited permission whitelists require separate owner/domain evidence. A declared signature is not permission or runtime evidence.
